text:
Type: multicolor square-pattern shag rug
Use: soft play and lounging area; kids room, teen room, living room, playroom
Style: contemporary, retro, modern
Materials: thick high pile shag tufted in blocks
Colors: charcoal grey base, turquoise, royal blue, magenta, light grey, white
Shape: rectangle covered in a grid of small soft squares, thick plush pile, dense pattern
Feel: playful, cheerful, cozy
Goes with: white or grey furniture, blue or pink accents; kids and teen rooms, colorful modern living spaces

product.name: MLBY
product.description: The high pile dampens sound and provides a soft surface to walk on.
